description: This file is a header file for the Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig API, providing declarations of functions to configure UDP Echo settings on a device. It includes licensing information, documentation comments, and function prototypes for setting enable flags, interface paths, and UDP ports related to UDP Echo diagnostics.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for UDP Echo diagnostics to allow or disallow the device to perform UDP Echo tests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Interface
methods.description: Sets the IP-layer interface over which the device will listen for UDP echo requests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_UDPPort
methods.description: Configures the UDP port on which the device's UDP server listens for echo requests.
